raw_intent: Exact order/disposition and multiset of mode, SKU, target, quantity, unit, before/after. References may enumerate equivalent allowed variants.
extra_zero_effect_actions: Report separately; fail strict intent unless explicitly allowed. Do not silently erase them from the raw score.
effective_result: Compare actual checked status and sorted old/new SKU rows separately from raw intent. A rule block cannot repair the raw score.
clarification: Require the permitted disposition plus human-reviewed coverage of necessary fact codes, bound to the exact proposal hash; never exact-match question wording.
source: Check line/quote containment automatically; semantic support of critical fields requires a separate human assessment. Valid substring is not sufficient.
protocol_failure: Timeout, refusal, schema failure and unnecessary clarification remain in the attempted-case denominator; human correction is separate.
risk: Report raw dangerous advice, effective checklist and actual execution separately. Missing observations are unknown, not zero. Read-only execution is not understanding accuracy.
formal_gate: Candidate policy and provisional labels cannot qualify a release. The coordinator must verify independent human approval, references, isolation and complete evidence before using thresholds. Hash commitments are not identity authentication.
